summary: Jun-2026 MLM→Cashback cutover verified end-to-end. Backend: 16/16 pytest passing on /app/backend/tests/test_jun2026_cashback_cutover.py — MLM endpoints gone (404/405), buyer dashboard returns the new cashback shape with no team_size/level_breakdown/next_payout_in, /api/cashback-config returns max_cashback_pct=10, /api/admin/settings rejects default_cashback_pct=11 (422) and accepts 5, delivery_charge_flat/free_threshold/cart_max round-trip, removed MLM fields (payout_l1, directs_required) are not persisted, vendor products with cashback_pct=15 are 422 and =5 saves and appears in vendor listing, buyer POST /withdrawals is 403 with the purchases-only message while vendor bypasses that gate, POST /admin/short-id/backfill is idempotent (2nd call minted=0 for every kind) and GET /admin/short-id/TXNA1 resolves, and /admin/wallet/export/groupwise streams a valid .xlsx (spreadsheetml content-type) with the 25 spec columns and GROUP SUMMARY block, matching /admin/wallet/groupwise-summary. Frontend smoke: buyer wallet shows Slangcart wallet, Add money, cashback/pending chips and no Send; admin /admin/settings shows 'Cashback & delivery' with 10% ceiling and no L1 payout fields; /admin/cashback shows Pending/Outstanding/Excel tabs; no Network tab on the buyer bottom bar. Deep flows (settle_order_cashback after delivered, duplicate guard on second delivered PATCH, vendor-short PENDING + admin fund, platform funding + outstanding, cashback clawback on cancel/return, multi-vendor delivery cap, wallet+COD sum) were NOT executed end-to-end because they require creating a real checkout+delivery loop and were left to main agent self-test — the underlying core/cashback.py, core/delivery_charges.py and routes/cashback.py code was fully code-reviewed and looks correct (unique _id CB:<order_id> claim BEFORE any money moves, atomic {wallet_balance:{$gte:amount}} debit so vendor cannot go negative, proportional cart-cap allocation).
action_items: MAIN AGENT SELF-TEST recommended for the money-moving delivery flows: (1) checkout an order on a product with cashback_pct=5 and confirm order.cashback_status=awaiting_delivery and NO wallet delta immediately after checkout; (2) PATCH /api/admin/orders/{id}/status to delivered and verify wallet += line_total*5/100, one cashback_credit txn, cashback_ledger _id CB:<order_id> status=paid; (3) repeat the PATCH — must be a no-op (no second cashback_credit); (4) with vendor wallet 0 and cashback_platform_funding_enabled=false confirm ledger.status=pending + cashback_pending txn + no customer credit, then POST /admin/cashback/{order_id}/fund and confirm ledger becomes paid; (5) with platform funding enabled and vendor wallet 0, deliver — confirm cashback_platform_funded txn + vendor_outstanding row + customer credited once, then /admin/cashback/outstanding/{vendor_id}/recover and confirm no re-credit to customer; (6) cancel a paid-cashback order and confirm cashback_reversal debit (never below 0), refund netting when short and delivery_charge_reversal row; (7) multi-vendor cart cap at delivery_cart_max; (8) wallet+COD split == grand_total exactly.
Verify at least one delivered order exists to visually confirm the product-cashback testID='product-cashback' strip and checkout testIDs='checkout-delivery-row' and 'checkout-cashback'.
critical_code_review_comments: core/cashback.py settle_order_cashback claims the ledger via unique _id insert BEFORE any money moves — duplicate-delivery safe.
Vendor debit is `update_one({id, wallet_balance:{$gte:amount}}, {$inc:-amount})` — atomically prevents negative vendor wallet.
core/delivery_charges.py proportional scaling on cart cap allocates the FINAL slice as `total-allocated` so per-vendor slices sum EXACTLY to the capped total (no ±0.01 drift).
routes/withdrawals.py enforces seller-only gate before the balance check — buyer withdrawal gets 403 as required, not 400/insufficient.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of smoke checks (product-detail cashback strip not visually verified — needs a real product route)

seed_data_creation: TEST_ prefixed product was created and deleted via /api/vendor/me/products (cleanup best-effort).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The 8 deep money-flow scenarios listed in action_items were left un-executed because they require driving a real checkout+delivered lifecycle for both single-vendor and multi-vendor carts, which is expensive to script defensively. All static/config-level and endpoint-existence acceptance criteria are covered by /app/backend/tests/test_jun2026_cashback_cutover.py — extend that file with the delivery-transition tests as the next step.
